promos.title: E18‑FireScream‑CeilingCollapse
promos.hook: Juliana screams, “Alexander!” as the bedroom erupts in flames.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander shouts, “Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!” just as the fire threatens to crush them.
promos.why: Starts with a visceral scream and ends on a life‑or‑death moment, forcing viewers to wonder if they survive.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander!
Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...
A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana! Get up!
Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: What happened?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Fire.
Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Stay close to me.
Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: We cannot get through!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then we go another way.
Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: The ledger!
Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Leave it!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No! No!
Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!

promos.title: Ep38‑Bell Alarm
promos.hook: Juliana’s eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
promos.cliffhanger: A sharp, high‑tension swell erupts as she whispers “Alexander…”, leaving the fate of the wedding and her execution unknown.
promos.why: The sudden bell sound instantly raises stakes, and the cut on the musical sting leaves the viewer desperate to know what happens next.

script.text: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Bells.
Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: The wedding.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It's beginning.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then I suppose I'm next.
Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...
A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

promos.title: Ep7: Husband's Silent Threat
promos.hook: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.
promos.cliffhanger: Gerald turns and flees, leaving the scarred bearded husband looming in the mud.
promos.why: A bold threat followed by the villain’s sudden fear creates instant tension that a new viewer can grasp without prior context.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: And your husband?

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Where is that beggar husband?
The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.

script.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
script.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: We are leaving.

promos.title: Ledger Tossed
promos.hook: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain‑soaked courtyard.
promos.cliffhanger: Choose your next words carefully.
promos.why: A shocking act of cruelty followed by a chilling threat makes a self‑contained, high‑tension bite.

script.text: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Barbara, don't!
A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.

script.speaker: CLARISSA
script.text: Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.
Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Here you go.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: They destroyed it.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: They dirtied it. That is not the same thing.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It was my mother's.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Then keep it.
The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Let them keep everything else.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: Look at you.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: Choose your next words carefully.

promos.title: Dead Man's Secret
promos.hook: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.
promos.cliffhanger: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence, hinting at a hidden enemy.
promos.why: A shocking confession about a fabricated death instantly hooks viewers, and the music cue leaves the conspiracy unresolved.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Who?
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I spent three years trying to find out.
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: The ambush was not an accident.
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Someone wanted me erased.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Who?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.
A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

promos.title: Cell Door Slam & Vow
promos.hook: Juliana (Crying Out, Broken): Please!
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana vows, “They will not take Alexander from me.”
promos.why: The brutal slam of the cell door and a desperate plea instantly hook the viewer, then her fierce promise raises the stakes of her imprisonment.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Please!
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Mother...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I have done nothing!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I saved her! I healed her!
Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I saved the Duchess!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: They took my mother's ledger...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me.

promos.title: E2_AbandonmentAccusation
promos.hook: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
promos.cliffhanger: The orchestral score swells as Juliana stands defiantly, leaving her fate unknown.
promos.why: A raw, accusatory line pulls viewers in, and the final musical swell hints at a powerful showdown without revealing the outcome.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.
Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

promos.title: E1_BetrayalHook
promos.hook: You should turn around, Juliana.
promos.cliffhanger: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
promos.why: Shows the brutal family betrayal instantly and ends on Juliana’s furious accusation, leaving viewers desperate to see her reaction.

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Why?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: Not anymore.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: What do you mean?

script.speaker: MATRIARCH
script.text: Look for yourself.
Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Gerald?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Why are you holding her hand?

script.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
script.text: Because he is marrying me.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: No...

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

promos.title: E3_StrangerIntervention
promos.hook: Take your hands off her.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana shakes her head ‘no’, eyes locked on the mysterious stranger as tension hangs in the air.
promos.why: A sudden command erupts into a violent showdown, ending on a tense, unanswered stare that begs viewers to watch what happens next.

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: Take your hands off her.

script.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
script.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: Stand aside, stranger!

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: I said...

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: ...let her go.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

script.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
script.text: Are you hurt?
Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

promos.title: Ep26_RingReveal
promos.hook: Juliana’s hand, glinting with a distinctive family ring, comes into view – the camera lingers on the unexpected jewelry.
promos.cliffhanger: The Dowager Duchess lunges, demanding “Where… where… where did you get this ring?” – the answer is still unknown.
promos.why: The mysterious ring instantly raises questions of identity and betrayal, and the Duchess’s frantic demand leaves the mystery hanging.

script.text: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
A sharp, stunned gasp.
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Your hand... Let me see your hand.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost.
The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Do not move!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!

promos.title: E16‑PowerCatch‑GeraldReveal
promos.hook: Alexander catches the iron pipe mid‑air with his bare hand.
promos.cliffhanger: The thug shouts, “Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!” leaving Juliana’s reaction unknown.
promos.why: Shows Alexander’s lethal skill instantly, then drops a bombshell about Gerald’s betrayal that hooks viewers.

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: Aaargh!
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.

script.speaker: BALD THUG
script.text: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.

script.speaker: THIRD THUG
script.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Alexander...

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Are you hurt?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Only my hands.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who sent you?

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: No one!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who?!

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Gerald...
The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

script.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
script.text: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!

promos.title: 32-iron-loom
promos.hook: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp): "You know nothing about my world."
promos.cliffhanger: CATHERINE hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana, the iron poised to strike.
promos.why: The taunt sets a fierce conflict and the looming brand leaves the outcome hanging, pulling viewers in.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I know exactly what your world values.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Beauty. Money.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Family. A perfect name.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And what is wrong with that?!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Silence! Silence!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Why?!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Because I am right!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You want everyone to fear you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But look at you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You insolent—!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You think you can lecture me?!
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!

promos.title: 44_RejectionWalk
promos.hook: Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander (Skeptical, Cutting): "Did you?"
promos.why: The bold arrest sets a tense tone, then Alexander’s cold question to Catherine leaves the fate of their love hanging.

script.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
script.text: Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.

script.speaker: LORD STERLING
script.text: You have no authority!

script.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
script.text: I have more than enough.
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Do something!
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Do you know what this did to me?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I mourned you.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I waited for you.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I never stopped loving you.
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You don't remember?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You were never my Duchess.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: But I loved you!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: No!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I loved you before all this!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Did you?

promos.title: Defiant Rejection
promos.hook: I will not become anyone's charity.
promos.cliffhanger: You have thrown yourself away!
promos.why: Shows Juliana’s fierce independence and ends on Gerald’s enraged outburst, leaving the conflict unresolved.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I will not become anyone's charity.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: It is a vow.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I don't know this man.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then I accept.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.

script.speaker: THE PRIEST
script.text: My- My Lady...

script.speaker: THE PRIEST
script.text: Are you certain?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I am.

script.speaker: THE PRIEST
script.text: Then... let us proceed.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You need not say anything you do not mean.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I truly mean it.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You have my protection.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You have my respect.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: And you have my word.

script.speaker: THE PRIEST
script.text: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...

script.speaker: THE PRIEST
script.text: ...husband and wife!
Dramatic musical chord swelling.

script.speaker: GERALD
script.text: You have thrown yourself away!

promos.title: 31-iron-threat
promos.hook: CATHERINE (Enraged Scream): "Enough!"
promos.cliffhanger: CATHERINE lifts the searing branding rod, the glowing tip stopping just inches from Juliana's eye.
promos.why: Shows the brutal power play and ends on a deadly brink that makes viewers wonder if Juliana will survive.

script.text: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Enough!
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: [gasping] Give it back!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: There. Finally. Something still hurts you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

promos.title: Thrust & Witchcraft Plot
promos.hook: Elder Nobleman (Fierce, Venomous): Then make certain she isn’t! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
promos.cliffhanger: Elder Nobleman (Cold, Calculating): Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.
promos.why: A violent thrust grabs attention, then the cold scheming to frame Juliana as a witch leaves the audience hanging on the impending trial.

script.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: What are you suggesting?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: You have a solution?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: We use the law to destroy her.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: The law?

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

promos.title: EP24_Riding_Crop_Strike
promos.hook: ACTION: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
promos.cliffhanger: LADY JULIANA (V.O., Steely, Unstoppable): “I will return. You cannot stop the healer.” – her defiant promise leaves the outcome of her secret plan unknown.
promos.why: A visceral whipping grabs attention, then Juliana’s hidden resolve hints a daring comeback, leaving viewers eager to see if she can outwit her oppressor.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Yes, my lady.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Clean it.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: All of it, my lady?

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: My lady—
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Do you want the same punishment?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: No, my lady.
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: That is where clever little servants belong.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I will return. You cannot stop the healer.

promos.title: Ep21_TobyCrisis
promos.hook: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana crushes the dried herbs and pours steaming water over them, but the scene cuts before we see if the remedy saves the boy.
promos.why: An urgent plea grabs attention, then the promo stops at the critical moment of the herbal cure, leaving the child's fate in suspense.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: We have no clinic now.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!
Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.
Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: His skin is burning hot.
Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!
Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.
Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

promos.title: 40‑WitchThreat
promos.hook: She won't be seeing anything for long.
promos.cliffhanger: And its witch will be dead.
promos.why: Immediate menace against Juliana hooks viewers, and the looming execution threat ends on a deadly promise.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: Good.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.
Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: We have an excellent view.

script.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
script.text: Of the wedding?

script.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
script.text: And everything that comes after it.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Everything must go perfectly.
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: All entrances are covered?

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: Every one, my Lord.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: Good.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

script.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
script.text: And its witch will be dead.
The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.

promos.title: Ep9: Rumor of the Duke
promos.hook: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
promos.cliffhanger: The Blond Nobleman whispers, “Impossible,” as the rumor about a scarred war veteran spreads.
promos.why: A stark warning about gossip followed by a nobleman's shaken reaction plants a dangerous secret that begs for answers.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Then we will face it together.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: What is it?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: What rumor?

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

script.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
script.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Where?

promos.title: 41‑CatherineShowdown
promos.hook: I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana: "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
promos.why: Catherine’s cruel proclamation and Juliana’s defiant retort create a tense stand‑off that stops just before any resolution.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Catherine...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Bring her in.
Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: There she is.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Look at her.

script.speaker: NOBLEMAN
script.text: She actually came back to the chapel.

script.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
script.text: Not as a bride this time.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.

promos.title: Vengeance Countdown
promos.hook: …and killing my wife afterward.
promos.cliffhanger: …their dead Duke is coming home.
promos.why: A chilling admission of murder sets a ticking clock, and the final ominous promise about the dead Duke leaves the audience desperate for the next move.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: They already took my name.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: They stole my home!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Two days.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Because before that wedding begins...

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.

promos.title: 45_DukeAndDuchess
promos.hook: Juliana (Emotional, Realizing): "It's you."
promos.cliffhanger: High Priest (Commanding, Severe): "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
promos.why: A heartfelt reunion instantly grabs attention, then the sudden legal challenge shatters the triumph, forcing viewers to wonder what will happen next.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It's you.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: It was always me.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You're the Duke?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: All this time?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I chose you because you were kind.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: You chose me when I had nothing.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I chose you because you had honor.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.
Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: No one will bow yet!
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.

promos.title: Conspiracy & Exposure
promos.hook: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?
promos.cliffhanger: Father Thomas warns that the pact hinges on Catherine’s silence, then Agnes bursts into the room and gasps at their illicit embrace – will the secret be exposed?
promos.why: Shows a high‑stakes treason pact and an immediate, shocking discovery, giving a cold viewer instant drama and a question that demands a click.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.
Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

script.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
script.text: The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet.
Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

promos.title: EP22_Threat_to_Maid
promos.hook: HOUSEKEEPER (Stern, Dismissive): “Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.”
promos.cliffhanger: LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring): “This isn’t ordinary fever.” – her horrified realization leaves the cause of the Duchess’s illness unknown.
promos.why: A brutal threat instantly shows Juliana’s danger, then the sudden, eerie diagnosis leaves viewers desperate to know the poison’s source.

script.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
script.text: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: That was close.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Where is the West Wing?

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: This house...
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Do not stare. Keep walking.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Your Grace?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Do not speak.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: This isn't ordinary fever.

promos.title: Ep25_HandGrab
promos.hook: Alexander steps directly into Juliana’s space, firmly taking her hand – a sudden, intimate grab that shocks the viewer.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander’s hand drops and clenches into a white‑knuckled fist as the tension spikes, leaving us wondering what he’s about to do.
promos.why: A visceral physical hook followed by the poisonous secret creates instant stakes that a new viewer can grasp without prior context.

script.text: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Lady Catherine.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Where did you meet her?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: What were you doing there?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I went there to help someone.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Who?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: The Dowager Duchess.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: The Dowager?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Prudence told me she was dying.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But it wasn't age.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: What did you find?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Poison.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Arsenic.
Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.

promos.title: 42‑AlexanderRevenge
promos.hook: You already know.
promos.cliffhanger: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.
promos.why: Alexander’s cold reveal and the final threat to Rupert leave the audience craving the inevitable showdown.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
script.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

promos.title: EP23_Poison_Realization
promos.hook: LADY JULIANA (Breathless, Reverent): “Mother.”
promos.cliffhanger: SOUND FX (Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway) – the imminent arrival of an unknown intruder stops the antidote in its tracks.
promos.why: A single, shocked word hints a deep secret, then the looming footsteps create a tense “someone’s coming” moment that begs a click.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Mother.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: What is it?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I have seen these symptoms before.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: What are you saying?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Someone is poisoning her.
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Poison?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: Arsenic.
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

script.speaker: PRUDENCE
script.text: Can you save her?

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: I can try.
Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

script.speaker: LADY JULIANA
script.text: The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly.
Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

promos.title: Ep37‑Betrayal Reveal
promos.hook: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.
promos.cliffhanger: Clarissa whispers, “And after the ceremony…”, hinting at a deadly surprise.
promos.why: A cold viewer instantly sees the cruel plan to marry and then kill Juliana, and is left hanging on the ominous promise.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Send the invitations.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.

script.speaker: BUTLER
script.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: Catherine's wedding.

script.speaker: NOBLEMAN
script.text: So it is finally official.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.

script.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
script.text: And after the ceremony...

promos.title: E17‑Promise‑BleedingHand
promos.hook: Alexander drops to one knee, taking Juliana’s trembling, bandaged hands.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana whispers, “I was frightened,” leaving us wondering if Alexander can truly keep her safe.
promos.why: A tender promise is made in a moment of visible danger, then cuts before the reassurance is given, creating emotional tension.

script.text: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: ...no one will hurt you again.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You cannot promise that.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I just did.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You were bleeding last night.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: So were you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You make it very difficult to argue with you.
Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I was frightened.

promos.title: 33-testimony-coercion
promos.hook: MAID (Crying, Shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"
promos.cliffhanger: LORD (Cold, Merciless): "That will be your testimony."
promos.why: A desperate plea under a cruel threat creates immediate tension, ending on the forced testimony that promises dire consequences.

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: What do you want me to say?!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: The truth.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Around him.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Like a circle?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: And she opened her mother's book...

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: Yes.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: She was praying!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: Praying... or chanting?

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: I don't know!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: You heard words you could not understand.

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: That is witchcraft.

script.speaker: MAID
script.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!

script.speaker: LORD
script.text: That will be your testimony.

promos.title: Catherine's Vengeful Plot
promos.hook: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.
promos.cliffhanger: That is precisely your job tonight.
promos.why: Catherine’s venomous confession of humiliation instantly grabs attention, then a secretive order leaves viewers hanging on what dark move she’ll make.

script.text: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Good. Let them remember it.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

script.speaker: AGNES
script.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.

script.speaker: AGNES
script.text: If someone sees him come to you...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Then no one sees him.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: That is precisely your job tonight.

promos.title: Ep27_RingMystery
promos.hook: The Dowager Duchess gasps, “This ring…”, instantly flagging a hidden connection.
promos.cliffhanger: A sudden, violent pounding on the double doors erupts, promising an imminent confrontation.
promos.why: A single line about the ring sparks intrigue, and the door‑banging cliffhanger forces viewers to wonder who’s coming and why.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: This ring...

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: He is no commoner. What does he do?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: My lost son wore that ring!

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: What is your husband's name?
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.

promos.title: Ep8: Beard Tension
promos.hook: You know more about healing than you let on.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander smiles, “We’ll see,” leaving Juliana’s offer to trim his beard hanging.
promos.why: A teasing line sparks curiosity, and the unresolved promise about the beard hints at deeper personal stakes.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You know more about healing than you let on.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Enough to survive.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Your hair and beard...

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I could trim them for you.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Not yet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Not yet?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Let them grow.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: It has advantages.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Very well.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: We'll see.

promos.title: 43_TreasonHook
promos.hook: You're lying!
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander: "Read the names."
promos.why: A frantic accusation erupts and the promise of damning evidence leaves viewers desperate to hear the names.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You're lying!
Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: I said arrest him!
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: We will not.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Your Duke!
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

script.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
script.text: No. He is your Duke.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You have all been deceived!

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Read the first.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.

script.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
script.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: No...

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Read the names.

promos.title: Cottage Door
promos.hook: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open, revealing a dark, barren room.
promos.cliffhanger: It is not much.
promos.why: The eerie opening sets a tense mood, and the final line leaves viewers wondering if this modest shelter will be enough.

script.text: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: I am sorry.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You came from comfort.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: This is all I can give you now.
Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It is quiet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Very quiet.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I think I like that.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You are not disappointed?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: I am.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: But not because of you.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: You don't have to do that tonight.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.
Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: There.

script.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
script.text: It is not much.

promos.title: Royal Seizure Threat
promos.hook: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown seizure.
promos.cliffhanger: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.
promos.why: The priest’s sudden decree shatters the wedding, then a looming ten‑day deadline leaves the Duke’s fate hanging.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.
Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!
The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

script.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
script.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

promos.title: Duchess Collapse → Identity Reveal
promos.hook: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
promos.cliffhanger: Catherine triumphantly declares, “Lady Juliana Ashcroft.”
promos.why: A sudden collapse throws the court into chaos, then the villain shatters Juliana’s secret identity, leaving viewers desperate to see her fate.

script.text: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Let me help her!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You see?

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.

script.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
script.text: I am not delusional!

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Of course you are not.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: You are merely confused.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

script.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
script.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: No!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: Give it back!

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: It belonged to my mother!

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: My mother's locket!
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Juliana...
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

promos.title: Ep19_MotherPrisoner
promos.hook: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
promos.cliffhanger: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open as Alexander steps into lantern light, leaving his next move unknown.
promos.why: A shocking family betrayal is revealed instantly, then the scene cuts just as Alexander prepares to act, urging viewers to find out his plan.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

script.speaker: INFORMANT
script.text: And when we have the proof?

script.speaker: ALEXANDER
script.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.
The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.

script.speaker: JULIANA
script.text: We have lost everything.

promos.title: Ep20_DuellingDuchy
promos.hook: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...
promos.cliffhanger: Rupert promises the peasants will learn their place when Catherine wears the ducal crown, leaving their ruthless scheme hanging.
promos.why: The hook drops a major power‑vacuum revelation, then the segment ends on the villains' ominous promise, compelling viewers to see how they’ll seize the title.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: ...the title is mine.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

script.speaker: CATHERINE
script.text: They disgust me.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

script.speaker: RUPERT
script.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.
